Every tile is a live 3D reconstruction of one human demonstration of the cup → plate task, built without any depth sensor: each object is reconstructed by SAM 3D from a single egocentric frame, registered into the recording's metric SLAM world, and then rides the tracked hand through the grasp — over a fused scene with the object footprints carved out. This composed scene, sampled as a point cloud, is exactly the observation the policy trains on. Tiles autoplay when visible; drag to rotate.
